Class SingleTargetUnit

java.lang.Object
models.base.Unit
models.base.SingleTargetUnit
All Implemented Interfaces:
Attackable, Moveable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Cat1, Dog1, FishCat, Hippo, KnightCat, Snake, Stickman
public class SingleTargetUnit extends Unit implements Attackable, Moveable
Abstract base class for units that attack one enemy at a time.

Each frame the unit checks for a single target in range via BattleManager.findSingleTargetInRange(Unit). If a target is found it locks in and begins the attack animation; damage is delivered on animation frame 3 by the inherited Unit.processAttackDamage() mechanism. When no target is present, the unit walks forward.

Concrete subclasses provide sprites and stat values through the SingleTargetUnit(String, double, double, double, double, double, double) constructor.

    • update

      public void update()
      Per-frame AI loop:
      1. Runs Unit.updateAnimation() to advance sprites and death phases.
      2. Returns early if the unit is dead or dying.
      3. Finds a target; if found, starts the attack animation and locks the target for frame-3 damage delivery.
      4. If no target is found, walks forward.
      Specified by:
      update in class Unit
